description: Robotics introduces how robots sense, think and move: safety, kinds of robots and how they move, the major fields of robotics, designing, building, programming and testing your own robot, competitions, and careers or hobbies.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The 2026 update added a careers-or-hobby choice as requirement 7.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Safety
requirements.summary: Hazards of working with robots, protective gear and first aid.

requirements.title: Robot basics
requirements.summary: What robots do, remote-controlled versus autonomous robots, and ways robots move.

requirements.title: Fields of robotics
requirements.summary: Several major fields of robotics and why they matter.

requirements.title: Building a robot
requirements.summary: Designing, building, programming and testing a robot, with an engineering notebook.

requirements.title: Demonstrating your robot
requirements.summary: Showing your robot and reviewing your notebook with your counselor.

requirements.title: Competitions
requirements.summary: One option: attending a robotics competition, or researching youth competitions.

requirements.title: Careers or hobbies
requirements.summary: One option: robotics careers, or a hobby that uses these skills.
